strategy.thesis: Independently managed, healthcare-focused venture firm operating in strategic partnership with sequencing company Illumina; backs early-stage companies pioneering breakthroughs in life-science tools, clinical diagnostics, therapeutics platforms, digital health and other applications of genomics.

sources.supports: Fund II size, total AUM, founding year, management structure, focus
sources.quote: closing of its second investment fund with total commitments of $325 million, bringing its total capital under management to $560 million ... Since its launch in 2016, Illumina Ventures has made investments in 25 companies ... an independently-managed, healthcare-focused venture firm ... in a strategic partnership with Illumina ... support early-stage companies that are pioneering breakthroughs in life science tools, clinical diagnostics, therapeutics platforms, digital health, and other applications of genomics

sources.title: Home - Illumina Ventures

sources.quote: Illumina Ventures has made 83 investments ... Illumina Ventures has 6 portfolio exits, with their latest portfolio exit being Stilla Technologies on February 13, 2025.

verification_notes: Anchor firm, in scope. Described by primary source as 'independently-managed' but in 'strategic partnership with Illumina'; some secondary sources (Global Venturing) label it the CVC arm of Illumina, hence subtype cvc. Press release datelined San Francisco; secondary sources (Crunchbase, Tracxn) list HQ as San Mateo, CA.
